statement.p: In 41.18 of the last 34 days it rained. How many days did it not rain? days

solution.p: We recall that a percent as a decimal is part/whole. Here that is \displaystyle\frac{{P}}{{34}}={0.4118}. We solve for P by multiplying by \displaystyle{34}. \displaystyle{P}={0.4118}\cdot{34}={14.0012}. This is the number of days that it rained. We want the non-rainy days which is 34-14.0012=19.9988 We round that as requested to 20.
